tagline: Zero-lag macOS file, app, bookmark & command launcher
brief: Native macOS frosted-vibrancy search launcher (⌥ F) across local files, iCloud Drive, Spotlight content, and multi-profile browser bookmarks & top sites. Sister product to Glance (Focal Frame).
criteria: Avoid magnifying-glass clichés; stay razor-sharp at 16 px monochrome in the macOS Menu Bar; pair naturally with Glance in Applications.

concepts.name: Aperture Lock
concepts.idea: Two opposing 45°-chamfered architectural viewfinder brackets locking onto a floating Steel Sapphire focal diamond.
rationale: Direct architectural sibling to Glance's Focal Frame without repeating its silhouette
Drops the magnifying-glass cliché while immediately communicating pinpoint focus
Three solid shapes with 30+ unit moats survive 16 px Menu Bar rendering effortlessly

recommendation: Aperture Lock — distinctive, architectural, 100/100 vector-clean, and built to sit directly beside Glance in macOS.
next_steps: Exported one-colour, reversed, and favicon variants
Ready to ship in Seek v1.1.0 Universal DMG
